negative_snippets:
I had a mixed experience at Aestay. On the positive side, the room was good, and the property itself is quite nice. I also want to commend the reception boy and the cleaning staff, as they were both professional and helpful during my stay.

However, I was very disappointed by the misleading information regarding the facilities. When I booked, I was specifically told there would be a kitchen available. Upon arrival, there was no kitchen to be found.

I tried to resolve this with the manager, Aaftab, who was the person who initially confirmed the kitchen facility to me. Unfortunately, he was unavailable, and despite calling him three times to discuss the issue, I received no response.

While the staff on-site are great, the management needs to be more transparent and reachable. I would caution future guests to double-check amenities before arriving.
